english.note: Use this when the sarcasm has an unpleasant, passive-aggressive, or deliberately odd tone.
Use this for a snide, affectedly strange cynical tone, especially in casual speech.

examples.english: They said sarcastically that I was really punctual, which made me even less willing to talk to them.
examples.traditional: 佢陰陽怪氣咁話我真係好準時，搞到我更加唔想同佢傾。

examples.english: You don't need to speak cynically like that; they really do want to help.
examples.traditional: 你唔使陰陽怪氣咁講，人哋真係想幫手㗎。
